source.title: Clogher Rural District, "Notice of Result of Elections: Election of Rural District Councillors for the above-named Rural District in the Year 1899", dated 7 April 1899, H. Irvine, returning officer (PRONI LA/24/3/AD/1; the owner's photographs of 10 November 2026, frames 403 and 405); compared with the Tyrone Constitution, 14 April 1899, p. 7 ("Elections: Result of the Polling in Tyrone")
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Clogher Rural District Council records)
source.check: read from the owner's photographs of the printed notice in two blind transcriptions by separate readers, which agreed on every name, figure and mark; a script checked that each division elects as many as its seats and that the elected are the top of the poll; abodes are not published

note: First election of the rural district council, held with the election of the board of guardians: each district electoral division returned its councillors, who were also its guardians. Polled in April 1899 and declared on Friday 7 April 1899 at the union boardroom (Tyrone Constitution, 14 April 1899, p. 7, "Elections: Result of the Polling in Tyrone"); the poll date, Thursday 6 April, is the day before the declaration and is still to be confirmed from a sentence in a newspaper. Fivemiletown returned 3 councillors, with a poll. Cowan's figure is printed with a broken second digit on both photographs ("7?"; most likely 70); it is left blank here. The Tyrone Constitution (14 April 1899, p. 7) prints the elected candidates' figures; those it prints agree with the notice. 5 candidates for 3 seats.
